## RE:volution Mod v1.3.12

### Added

- Added the first deterministic Location Generation Foundation.
- Added immutable `LocationTemplate` and pure `LocationGenerationPlanner` contracts, separated from Minecraft world mutation and persistence.
- Added `/location create <locationId> <mobSlotId> [seed]` for creating an empty configured `MOB_ZONE` around the executing admin.
- Added stable default seed derivation from world seed, Location/stage ids and block anchor, plus optional explicit signed 64-bit seeds.
- Added planned stage rotation and extension points for flower clearings, tree clusters and rock clusters.
- Added immediate runtime topology refresh after provisioning.
- Added JUnit coverage for deterministic plans, empty stage provisioning, duplicate guards and Boss Zone ordering rules.

### Fixed

- Prevented generated stage configuration from being created after an existing Boss Zone in the same Location.
- Prevented accidental duplicate stage provisioning from overwriting an existing configured stage.

### Other

- v1.3.12 foundation persists stage geometry only. It intentionally does not place Minecraft blocks or structures yet.
- Mob population, Boss assignment, transition-point placement, terrain sculpting and final construction assets remain separate future steps.
- The planning contract is designed so a later REBuilder/template world adapter can apply the same deterministic plan without coupling generation policy to Forge or MongoDB.

### Download

Download `RE-volution-1.3.12.jar` from the assets attached to this GitHub Release when v1.3.12 is promoted to stable.
